description: Crash log in, culprit shortlist out. Parses the log, then correlates its suspects with the loaded plugins and (with a gameId) the known-conflict database into one bundle: which suspected mods are actually in the load order, at what index, and which loaded plugins have known conflicts. It lines up the evidence; it does NOT name the cause — that's the model's call, reasoned over the data. Use when the user says "what's causing my crash", "which mod is it", or pastes a crash log and wants the answer.

gameId.description: Canonical game id (e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition', 'fallout4') to include the known-conflict cross-check. Omit to skip it.

logContent.description: Crashlog content as a string. Provide this OR logPath.

logPath.description: Absolute path to a crashlog on disk (the SKSE/F4SE crash folder, or the game's BepInEx/LogOutput.log).

logType.description: Format hint. Default 'auto' — detect from content.

name: mw_diagnose_crash
